# AgReCir

> AgReCir Impact (Private) Limited is an agriculture company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Karachi, Pakistan. It organises and trains farmers, runs internal inspections, prepares farms for organic, regenerative and other certifications, and links harvests to ginners, buyers and processors, for textile mills, brands, food companies and development partners. Member of IFOAM – Organics International.

Key facts (2026): 33,500 acres (13,557 ha) of cotton in organic and regenerative programmes; 12 projects across cotton, fruit, rice, oilseeds, spices and flowers; work in 8 countries (Pakistan, Tanzania, Kenya, Malaysia, UAE, Türkiye, Slovenia, Sri Lanka). Founder & Managing Director: Mukhdoom Mashhood Ahmed. AgReCir is not a certification body; it prepares farms for certification by accredited bodies. Also written as: AgReCir Impact, Agrecir, AIPL.
